about: The owner's standard test set ('the test we have been running on Tonetta', 2026-09-30): each asset's source is the job whose plan is the best tuned so far (zones, glass, cockpit insert, lettering). `ms bench --model <key>` clones each, re-seeds it and assembles it; `--keep-seed` re-assembles the same seeds with the current code for free. Baselines are the owner-visible scores those jobs got.
